# Jaipur Stonecraft

> Jaipur Stonecraft is a premier stone atelier and bespoke manufacturer based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India, specializing in hand-carved Makrana white marble deity statues, home mandirs, temple architecture, lattice jalis, courtyard fountains, relief murals, and custom architectural stonework.

Built upon generational Rajasthani masonic lineage, Jaipur Stonecraft operates a dedicated carving atelier serving private homeowners, architects, interior designers, temple trusts, and cultural collectors globally. All works are hand-carved from single-block natural stone following traditional Shilpa Shastra proportions, zero-chemical hand polishing, and precision architectural tolerances.

## Primary Stone Materials Offered
- **Makrana Pure White Marble**: Dense calcite marble from Makrana, Rajasthan, traditional for sacred temple idols and home mandirs due to its enduring luster and low natural porosity.
- **Sangemarmar & Ambaji White Marble**: Fine-grained crystalline white marbles chosen for delicate devotional facial chiseling.
- **Black Bhainslana Marble**: Dense, deep black stone quarried in Rajasthan for Shiva idols and sculptural art.
- **Pink Bansi Paharpur Sandstone**: Historic pink sandstone quarried in Rajasthan, renowned for temple shikharas and architectural carvings.
- **Jodhpur Red Sandstone**: High-durability red sandstone used for grand columns, arches, and heritage outdoor facades.
- **Dholpur Beige Sandstone**: Uniform, warm beige sandstone for garden fountains, relief panels, and architectural jalis.
- **Jaisalmer Golden Yellow Limestone**: Warm golden fossiliferous limestone for ornate decorative accents.
- **Natural Translucent Onyx**: Naturally banded semi-precious stone for backlit panels and decorative sanctuary features.
- **Granite**: Offered where suitable and available for specific architectural, landscape, or structural commissions. Specific variety, color, and finish depend on project requirements and atelier confirmation.
*(Note: Jaipur Stonecraft works predominantly with natural marbles, sandstones, limestones, onyx, and select granites. Contact the atelier to review material suitability and availability for your project.)*

## Core Collections
- [Marble Sculptures & Deity Statues](https://jaipurstonecraft.com/collections/sculptures-statues): Hand-carved Hindu and Jain sacred deity idols (Ganesha, Radha Krishna, Shiva, Hanuman, Durga, Saraswati, Buddha, Jain Tirthankaras) and custom portrait busts in pure Makrana white marble.
- [Wall Art & Relief Panels](https://jaipurstonecraft.com/collections/wall-art-reliefs): Intricate bas-relief wall murals, temple narrative carvings, floral medallions, and backlit translucent stone art.
- [Temples & Architectural Stonework](https://jaipurstonecraft.com/collections/temples-architectural-stonework): Custom white marble home mandirs, shikharas, carved pillars, toran arches, and grand temple sanctum architecture.
- [Fountains & Water Features](https://jaipurstonecraft.com/collections/fountains-water-features): Hand-carved marble courtyard fountains, tiered lotus bowls, and sculptural water walls.
- [Decorative Stone Art](https://jaipurstonecraft.com/collections/decorative-stone-art): Sculptural planters, urli bowls, candle holders, and luxury artisan tabletop pieces.
- [Custom & Bespoke Creations](https://jaipurstonecraft.com/collections/custom-bespoke-creations): Commissioned portrait busts, family memorial sculptures, architect-designed focal points, and bespoke temple elements.

## Architectural & Bespoke Services
- [Custom Stone Projects](https://jaipurstonecraft.com/custom-projects): End-to-end bespoke commissions from 2D architectural drawings or 3D clay maquettes to final hand-chiseling.
- [Craftsmanship Process](https://jaipurstonecraft.com/craftsmanship): Five-stage carving lineage: quarry block selection, Shilpa Shastra grid layout, rough chiseling, fine facial detailing (Netra Unmilan), and zero-chemical emery buffing.
- [Worldwide Export & Packaging](https://jaipurstonecraft.com/export): Specialized international logistics in ISPM-15 certified heat-treated wooden crates with high-density shock foam, port clearance, and fully insured sea/air transit across the USA, UK, UAE, Australia, and Europe.
- [Our Story & Heritage](https://jaipurstonecraft.com/our-story): Generational masonic lineage, values of ethical quarrying, fair artisan wages, and preservation of Jaipur's stone carving heritage.

## Knowledge Guides & Material Specifications
- [How Makrana Marble Statues Are Carved](https://jaipurstonecraft.com/knowledge/how-makrana-marble-statues-are-carved): Detailed craftsman guide on block selection, chisel geometry, facial carving, and natural luster finishing.
- [Selecting Marble for Home Mandirs](https://jaipurstonecraft.com/knowledge/selecting-marble-for-home-mandir): Practical guide to sizing, pooja room weight loading, non-porous durability, and arch proportions.
- [Makrana Marble vs Artificial Stone](https://jaipurstonecraft.com/knowledge/differences-between-makrana-marble-and-artificial-stone): Factual comparison between natural calcite marble and synthetic cultured/resin marble regarding heat resistance, ritual purity, and multi-century lifespan.
- [Stone Jali Screens Architectural Guide](https://jaipurstonecraft.com/knowledge/choosing-stone-jali-screens-guide): Comprehensive guide on lattice thickness, structural wind loading, pattern geometry, and indoor/outdoor applications.
- [Architect & Temple Trust Specification Guide](https://jaipurstonecraft.com/knowledge/architect-specification-guide-custom-stonework): Technical specifications required for accurate stone carving quotations, shop drawings, tolerances, and anchor systems.
- [Care & Maintenance for Marble Statues](https://jaipurstonecraft.com/knowledge/marble-statue-care-and-maintenance): Conservation guidelines for cleaning sacred murtis, preventing staining from oils, vermilion/kumkum, and safe restoration.
